description: Election Commission - Revision of Electoral Rolls - 2020
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses electoral registration processes under the Registration of Electors Act and its amendments. It outlines procedures for internally displaced persons and their children to register as electors, sets application timelines (May 4-10, 2021), and discusses the preparation of a supplementary register of electors for 2020. The content is issued by the Election Commission and focuses entirely on electoral matters, making it a clear fit for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
